% =====================================================================
% main.tex -- HSC Physics Revision Guide, one module.
%
% HOW TO USE: copy this file to src/<mod>/main.tex (do not edit the
% copy in common/). Build with:
%
% Every part is optional: a missing file is skipped, so a half-finished book
% still compiles. Chapter N always prints as "Chapter N", even when an
% earlier chapter file is missing.
%
% Book order (fixed for all four books):
%   cover - How to use this guide - Contents - Module overview   (frontmatter.tex)
%   chapters ch1.tex ... ch8.tex
%   Answering HSC questions                                       (answering.tex)
%   Formula sheet explained                                       (formulasheet.tex)
%   Glossary                                                      (glossary.tex)
%   Practice set                                                  (practice.tex)
%   Answers: ch1_answers.tex ... ch8_answers.tex, then practice_answers.tex
%   Last-minute summary                                           (summary.tex)
% =====================================================================
\documentclass[11pt,a4paper,oneside,openany]{book}
\makeatletter\def\input@path{{./}{../common/}}\makeatother
\usepackage{hscphys}
\IfFileExists{./module_info.tex}{\input{./module_info}}{}

\begin{document}

%% ---------------------------------------------------------------- front
% frontmatter.tex = \makecover, \input{../common/howtouse}, \tableofcontents,
% Module overview (copy common/frontmatter_template.tex to start it).
\IfFileExists{./frontmatter.tex}{\input{./frontmatter}}{%
  \makecover
  \IfFileExists{../common/howtouse.tex}{\input{../common/howtouse}}{}%
  \tableofcontents}

%% ---------------------------------------------------------------- chapters
\IfFileExists{./ch1.tex}{\setcounter{chapter}{0}\input{./ch1}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch2.tex}{\setcounter{chapter}{1}\input{./ch2}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch3.tex}{\setcounter{chapter}{2}\input{./ch3}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch4.tex}{\setcounter{chapter}{3}\input{./ch4}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch5.tex}{\setcounter{chapter}{4}\input{./ch5}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch6.tex}{\setcounter{chapter}{5}\input{./ch6}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch7.tex}{\setcounter{chapter}{6}\input{./ch7}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch8.tex}{\setcounter{chapter}{7}\input{./ch8}}{}

%% ---------------------------------------------------------------- back
\IfFileExists{./answering.tex}{\input{./answering}}{}
\IfFileExists{./formulasheet.tex}{\input{./formulasheet}}{}
\IfFileExists{./glossary.tex}{\input{./glossary}}{}
\IfFileExists{./practice.tex}{\input{./practice}}{}

%% ---------------------------------------------------------------- answers
% The "Answers" heading is printed only if at least one answers file exists.
\newif\ifanyanswers
\IfFileExists{./ch1_answers.tex}{\anyanswerstrue}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch2_answers.tex}{\anyanswerstrue}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch3_answers.tex}{\anyanswerstrue}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch4_answers.tex}{\anyanswerstrue}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch5_answers.tex}{\anyanswerstrue}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch6_answers.tex}{\anyanswerstrue}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch7_answers.tex}{\anyanswerstrue}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch8_answers.tex}{\anyanswerstrue}{}
\IfFileExists{./practice_answers.tex}{\anyanswerstrue}{}
\ifanyanswers
  \unnumberedchapter[\faCheckDouble]{Answers}
  Full worked answers to every Quick check (numbered like Q2.3) and to the
  Practice set. Click a question number to jump back to the question.
\fi
\IfFileExists{./ch1_answers.tex}{\input{./ch1_answers}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch2_answers.tex}{\input{./ch2_answers}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch3_answers.tex}{\input{./ch3_answers}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch4_answers.tex}{\input{./ch4_answers}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch5_answers.tex}{\input{./ch5_answers}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch6_answers.tex}{\input{./ch6_answers}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch7_answers.tex}{\input{./ch7_answers}}{}
\IfFileExists{./ch8_answers.tex}{\input{./ch8_answers}}{}
\IfFileExists{./practice_answers.tex}{\clearpage\input{./practice_answers}}{}

%% ---------------------------------------------------------------- summary
\IfFileExists{./summary.tex}{\input{./summary}}{}

\end{document}
